recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14828 unless Pharmacy opens a new tracker to revisit using the Dosage datatype for MedicationAdministration.dosage.
issue_request: FHIR-14828 was a Published FHIR-core Pharmacy change request asking whether MedicationAdministration.dosage could be the shared Dosage datatype. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected that type change because MedicationAdministration is an event and not all Dosage attributes are appropriate, and instead required the note: "This is a constrained list of attributes from the Dosage type.  These are the only attributes needed to describe the dose administered."
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit 73c779d3aeb5a6120955eb499d67727c2fdfdf47 applied FHIR-14828 by adding the exact constrained-list text to the MedicationAdministration.dosage Committee Notes column in the spreadsheet source. Later source refactors converted the spreadsheet to StructureDefinition XML and preserved the text as the build committee-notes extension.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition defines MedicationAdministration.dosage as BackboneElement, not Dosage, and includes the exact note on that element. Related-Jira and FHIR-14828-specific Zulip/Confluence searches found no later evidence requiring a different interpretation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scope source already implements the final Jira decision.
